notes.title: v0.10260b ALPHA
notes.notes: -We have optimized a couple of underlying components to improve game performance.

notes.title: v0.10259c ALPHA
notes.notes:
-Connection is now stable after returning to main menu

-The scoreboard menu now works correctly

-Players will now auto equip their weapons after casting a spell

-Footsteps are now softer when the player is not sprinting

-Knocked out players no longer make any sound

notes.title: v0.10259b ALPHA
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where items did not show up in the inventory

-After switching sides, players now start with the correct amount of currency

-Players now spawn further apart

-The weapon slot now correctly refreshes when a new round starts

-Cases where players did not receive Prime Bits after a game has been completed has been resolved

-Some settings menu options were unresponsive, and now work as intended

-Weapon icons now line up perfectly with their buttons in the buy menu

-Some weapons and items in the buy menu were disabled even though the player could afford them, this is no longer a problem

-a Few weapons were incorrectly priced in the buy menu and has been rectified

-Aiming at an item will now show the keybind to pick it up

-Players can no longer buy more items than the inventory size

-Resetting spells in the spell select menu now resets both spells
